name: Regional low-rank training-capacity diagnostic
status: Prospective training-only diagnostic; no held-out Dice selection
sampling_rule: First four distinct sequences in the archived Run 127 fold-3 epoch-0 training schedule, in recorded order. Do not select clips by validation outcomes or native failure severity.
method: Current verified one-read, dense native-memory regional low-rank adapter; shared author LoRA parameters, unchanged native writer and raw decoder supervision. Train regional and per-frame global-control arms on identical clips in fixed round-robin order, with identical starting parameters.
measurements: Before training and after exactly 20 updates, measure all four fixed training-clip losses. Save every update's loss, gradient norms, factor norms and actual layer/key/pointer records. Require finite losses, nonzero B-factor gradients in all four layers, unchanged backbone and source hashes; verify native replay on each initial clip.
decision: If mean training loss does not decrease or integrity fails, diagnose before full CV. A decrease only shows optimization responsiveness; it is not an accuracy success or a basis for selecting a checkpoint by held-out outcomes. Save the final fixed-step weights, not best validation weights. No learning-rate sweep, frame selection, exclusion, added threshold or confidence gate.
scope: Exploratory PolypGen training-only mechanism check; patient independence unverified. These weights are not a final method candidate. All experiment and tracking files remain in Drive.
